task.title: P6-118: Make removed rows consistent in section header and selection
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-118. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**A removed row stays internally inconsistent until a refetch: the deck section header still counts it, and it keeps its selection checkbox** (was `P6-055d` + `P6-055e`). `section_slots` sums `row.present` with no `here_delta` (`collection.rs:1146-1160`, rendered `:1224`) while the page header does apply the delta (`:664`/`:698`), so the section header contradicts both the row's "—" and the page header. And `selectable` is computed off the pre-removal fetch and is not reactive on `removed` (`:1345`, checkbox still rendered at `:1380`), so selecting a removed row yields a `NoCopies` refusal instead of being unselectable.
